mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users ( email, password, name, phone, profile_image, role, social_type, social_id, is_email_verified, gender, age_group, job, marital_status, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{email}, #{password}, #{name}, #{phone}, #{profileImage}, #{role}, #{socialType}, #{socialId}, #{isEmailVerified}, #{gender}, #{ageGroup.value}, #{job}, #{maritalStatus}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = #{email} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM users WHERE email = #{email} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET password = #{password}, name = #{name}, phone = #{phone}, profile_image = #{profileImage}, is_email_verified = #{isEmailVerified}, gender = #{gender}, age_group = #{ageGroup}, job = #{job}, marital_status = #{maritalStatus}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
